infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: CheckAll@t uses your location to show nearby service providers, set your addresses and, during a delivery or service you carry out, let your client follow your arrival in real time.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: When you carry out a delivery or a service, CheckAll@t keeps sharing your location with your client while you use a navigation app, until the mission ends. It is never used outside an active mission.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: CheckAll@t uses your camera to take before/after photos for service orders.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: CheckAll@t accesses your photos to upload profile pictures and proof photos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: CheckAll@t saves photos to your library.
